specs.Compatible Devices: Devices with Wi-Fi and/or Bluetooth connectivity, external flash units, and other accessories with a hot shoe mount
specs.Item Type Name: EOS R50 RF-S18-45mm IS STM Kit (White)

features: Sensor: Full frame CMOS AF II Sensor with 24.2 MP (brilliant resolution for large prints and image cropping)

Image Processor: DIGIC X with 651 autofocus points (important for speed and accuracy of autofocus and burst photography);Video Resolution: 4k UHD HQ upto 30fps with fully manual control and selectable frame rates (great for precision and high-quality video work)
Connectivity: WiFi, NFC and Bluetooth built-in (useful for remotely controlling your camera and transferring pictures wirelessly as you shoot)
Lens Mount: EF-S mount compatible with all EF and EF-S lenses (crop-sensor mount versatile and compact, especially when used with EF-S lenses)
Canon EOS R50 Mirrorless Camera with 18-45mm Lens pairs the white multimedia mirrorless camera with the white RF-S 18-45mm f/4.5-6.3 IS STM standard zoom lens.
description: The EOS R50 camera makes photography fun, simple, and convenient with intuitive photo functions that capture beautiful images automatically, just as you imagine them. A host of video functions such as 6K oversampled 4K 30p capture and Dual Pixel CMOS AF II makes the EOS R50 a great camera for movie recording and vlogging as well. The 24.2 Megapixel APS-C size CMOS Image sensor and DIGIC X image processor ensure high image quality in a compact and lightweight form factor. The RF-S18-45mm F4.5-6.3 IS STM is a small, lightweight, and versatile lens that is designed to fit into your life without taking up your whole camera bag. The RF-S55-210mm F5-7.1 IS STM telephoto zoom lens provides additional range to capture sharp images of far-away subjects.
